{{Quote|Here's an old Leffingite favorite, made fresh from juicy, Kessinnamon-spiced Almakian apples baked to perfection in a golden pom seed flour crust.|Dex's Diner menu, on its all-Almakian apple pie|<ref name="Menu" />}}
'''Kessinnamon''' was a type of culinary [[Spice/Legends|spice]]. It was used to flavour the [[Almakian apple/Legends|Almakian apples]] in [[All-Almakian apple pie]] which was served in [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The [[Restaurant/Legends|resaurant]] also sold [[kessinnamon roll]]s as a [[Foodstuff/Legends|breakfast]] side.<ref name="Menu" />  

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|A portmanteau of "Kessel" and "cinnamon," presumably describing where it comes from and what it tastes lik|Gregory Walker on naming the Kessinnamon|<ref name="Story Behind">{{Blog|narbflick|11|Dining at Dex's: The Story Behind the Story}}</ref>}}
Kessinnamon was mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Menu" /> In a blog post released the following day, Walker revealed that Kessinnamon was a [[Wikipedia:portmanteau|portmanteau]] of [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]] and [[Cinnamon/Legends|cinnamon]].<ref name="Story Behind" />
